Libraries the dashboard uses, kept here so the site works without reaching the internet.
Each is the unchanged file from npm (only the "sourceMappingURL" comment line removed).

chart.umd.js   Chart.js 4.5.1      https://www.chartjs.org     MIT licence   (the charts)
motion.js      motion 13.4.0       https://motion.dev          MIT licence   (animations; the plain-JavaScript
                                                                              version of Framer Motion)
lenis.min.js   lenis 1.3.26        https://lenis.darkroom.engineering   MIT licence   (smooth scrolling)
lenis.css      lenis 1.3.26        the CSS that goes with it

../fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin.woff2   Plus Jakarta Sans (variable), @fontsource-variable 5.3.0,
                                         SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see ../fonts/OFL-LICENSE.txt)
